startup_file.what: Runs premium flexible and managed workspace centres across India. It had 58 operating centres at the end of FY26 and 72 by July 2026.
how: Rent from customers who use its centres: Rs 173.6 Cr of Rs 201.3 Cr operating revenue in FY26, about 86%.
Other operational income (ancillary services): Rs 27.6 Cr, up from Rs 5.4 Cr.
startup_file.watch: Profit quality: other income was Rs 38.9 Cr, including a Rs 36.7 Cr gain on terminating lease contracts. Without that gain the profit jump would look much smaller. The article gives growth drivers as more centres, higher occupancy and better pricing.

country.name: Canada
country.trend: Tightening on temporary; PR volumes steady
country.pr: PR is granted on arrival through Express Entry or a provincial nomination (general knowledge). Levels plan 2026-2028: 380,000 new permanent residents a year; economic share rising to 64% in 2027-2028. A one-time measure fast-tracks PR for up to 33,000 temporary workers in 2026-2027.
country.citizenship: About 3 years of physical presence within 5 years (general knowledge, not re-verified). Dual citizenship allowed.
country.pro: Only country on this list where you can apply for PR from outside without an employer.
country.con: New temporary arrivals cut to 385,000 in 2026 (study permits about 49% lower, worker permits about 37% lower); goal is temporary residents under 5% of population by end-2027.
country.watch: Express Entry draw scores and categories
